sentĭcōsus , a, um, adj. id.,
I.full of briers or thorns, thorny, briery (ante- and post-class.); “trop.: verba, Afr. ap. Fest. s. v. sentes, p. 339 Müll.: merces (with aspera),” App. Flor. p. 361, 1 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
